name: jmwmllc
description: jmwmllc's Claude Code skills. feedback-mode — installs a dev-only, framework-agnostic in-browser feedback-capture widget into any web project and defines the mission-control payload contract. agent-queue — sets up an autonomous agent work queue: an in-app 'send to agent' flag, a bearer-token list/ack API, a local puller, and a scheduled worker that builds/verifies/commits/acks queued tasks, with safety rails and a self-expiry.
